title: 12-apps: delegation token CoAP integration — issuance, presentation, seq cache (18.8.6)
description: spec/12-apps.md 18.8.6. Crypto layer is complete (python/src/lichen/crypto/delegation_tokens.py: COSE_Sign1, scope bitmap, admin 0x13 restriction, vectors delegation_tokens.json) but no CoAP integration: (1) no POST /groups/{gid}/tokens issuance endpoint; (2) groups_invite.py does not accept the delegation field / presentation form; (3) no caller maintains the (delegator,delegate,resource,seq) replay cache — cached_seq is a bare parameter (delegation_tokens.py:323,388) so spec validation steps 2 (roster lookup), 10, and 11 are unperformed. Suggested placement: wire verify_delegation_token into groups_invite.py with an in-RAM seq cache. See docs/spec-coverage/12-apps.md R-12-074/075/076.
